bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to transportation; appropriating money for airport improvements in the city of McGregor.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; MCGREGOR AIRPORT AUTOMATED WEATHER STATION. +]

[+$150,000 in fiscal year 2025 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of transportation for a grant to the city of McGregor to relocate the automated weather station at the McGregor Isedor Iverson Airport. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective the day following final enactment. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to transportation; appropriating money for airport improvements in the city of McGregor.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; MCGREGOR AIRPORT AUTOMATED WEATHER STATION.

$150,000 in fiscal year 2025 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of transportation for a grant to the city of McGregor to relocate the automated weather station at the McGregor Isedor Iverson Airport.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.
